verdict.rationale: Unity documents automation surfaces: Editor command-line arguments, Build Automation, the Unity CLI and AI Assistant workflows. None of the evidence shows a first-party way to version, review or roll back those automations. Build Automation's support for version control systems means it builds from the user's VCS, which is an adjacent integration rather than versioning of the automations themselves.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
